description:
The NSWCPD intends to procure three (3) customized digial podiums in accordance with Section C, Statement of Work of the request for quotation. This procurement is a total small business set aside. Please reference the attached RFQ for additional information. The contract will be Firm Fixed Price.

All responses must be sent to Brooke Steele at brooke.a.steele3.civ@us.navy.mil no later than 5:30 PM EST on 26 March 2026.

Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
